name: Put-That-There
summary: The original voice-and-gesture interface: point at an object on a wall display and say "that" to select it.
howItWorks: A sensor on the wrist tracks where the user points on a large wall display. Spoken commands with deictic words ("put that ... there") are resolved against the pointing direction at the moment each word is spoken.

relationships.note: Pairs a pointing channel with speech.
